name: next-steps
description: A What next? button above the prompt: on press, suggests up to three next prompts; 1, 2 or 3 puts one into the input box as a draft, 0 hides them. A fork of Thariq Shihipar's next-steps, which suggested after every turn.

language.title: Language / Мова
language.description: auto follows Claude's response language from /config; en or uk set it explicitly. auto бере мову відповідей Claude з /config; en чи uk задають її явно.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer that offers the button
minAnswerChars.description: No What next? button after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Give the suggester the session's skills and slash commands, so a suggestion can be one of them.
